models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Light SE breeze, near-flat sea - Panarea buoys quiet tonight, easy 28 nm downwind run to Filicudi tomorrow.
briefing.synopsis: No organised pressure system is showing in the data for our area - the pattern is a slack, light easterly to southeasterly regime across the Aeolians with nothing more than Force 2-3 anywhere in the forecast. ECMWF IFS (05 Oct 18Z) and ICON-2i (06 Oct 00Z) both keep Panarea winds in the 3-9 kt band through tonight, backing SSE around midnight, then easing to around 6 kt SSE by 06:00 Tuesday. Through Wednesday the breeze stays SE-ESE and light, with the first real filling-in deferred to Friday's Salina-Portorosa leg when W-WNW 9-12 kt and 2.5-2.8 ft seas appear in the IFS run. Seas remain under about 1 ft in the island group through tomorrow.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: Recommended berth is the San Pietro buoy field, scored sheltered at 0.83 with SSE 9 kt and 0.4 ft SSW swell (ECMWF IFS, 05 Oct 18Z). The caveat is honest: SSE blows straight into San Pietro's exposed arc, but at 9 kt mean with a gust of 21.6 kt flagged at midnight it should be no more than a rolly hour or two. Drautto and Cala Zimmari score essentially the same (0.80 and 0.81) and share the same SSE exposure, so the choice does not materially matter tonight. If the SSE comes in harder than forecast or swell builds past the 0.4 ft shown, Cala Zimmari gives the tightest tuck for a short shift.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: Tuesday 07 Oct, Panarea to Filicudi, 28 nm on 259°T. Recommended departure 06:00: SSE 6.8 kt, gusts to 17.3 kt, 0.7 ft seas, broad reach at 105 TWA, arriving about 10:00 - verdict go, with the caveat that that gust is an interval maximum from a single model in light air, not a sustained figure. The window does not close: departures at 08:00, 10:00, 12:00 and 14:00 all read 7-9 kt SE-ESE with seas building only from 0.8 to 1.1 ft. Expect to motor-sail part of the way; 12:00 gives the best angle at 142 TWA if anyone wants a lie-in.

passage_notes.note: 11 nm on 219°T, already behind us - SE 5-8 kt, seas 0.2-0.4 ft, beam reach, go at every window.
28 nm, 259°T. SSE-ESE 7-9 kt, seas 0.7-1.1 ft, broad reach all day. Go from 06:00 through 14:00; no deterioration time flagged.

15 nm, 092°T. Very light ESE-SE 4-7 kt and 0.5-0.8 ft seas - mostly a motor, with the 06:00 and 08:00 windows close to head-to-wind. The 14:00 window shows a 24.7 kt interval-max gust against a 6 kt mean; treat it as noise rather than a forecast of wind, but keep the main reefable.

24 nm, 156°T. First real breeze of the week: W-WNW 8.5-11.7 kt, gusts 11-21 kt, seas 1.4-2.8 ft, broad reach throughout. The 08:00 departure is the strongest at 11.7 kt / 2.5 ft. Three days out - expect this one to move.

cautions: Panarea's buoy fields are all open to the SSE tonight and that is exactly where the wind sits; a 21.6 kt gust is flagged around midnight at San Pietro (ECMWF IFS, 05 Oct 18Z). Snubbers on and a wake-up plan if it builds.

Gust figures from ECMWF IFS are interval maxima, not instantaneous - the 17-25 kt gusts quoted against 6-8 kt means on Tuesday and Wednesday will look dramatic on the page and mild on the water. Do not reef for them, but do not ignore a squall line either.
The models part company at a few hours: Panarea midday Tuesday spreads 5.5-12.9 kt across runs, and Stromboli midday Tuesday 5.1-14.0 kt. Plan for the top of those ranges, not the mean.
briefing.confidence_note: IFS, AIFS and ICON-2i agree on a light SE regime for tonight and tomorrow, and the stability record shows mean wind shifts of only 0.5-0.9 kt at 0-24 h lead; confidence drops for Friday's Portorosa leg where 72-120 h shifts average 2.3 kt and 40 degrees.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
